A reader citing the unit could take both halves as demonstrated here.

description: The scope claim that the assertions hold for ANY time period is used as supporting evidence but is never a unit in its own right. It is the strongest thing the passage says -- it rules out the standard defence that active management wins over some horizons -- and it is separately checkable from the assertions themselves.
